item.description:

Russia also reported a drone that wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast, and Ukraine captured its first Indonesian prisoner of war amid a surge in Russian recruitment. A senior US soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of spying for Russia. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
